description: This is a unit test class for the CandidateOfferDecliningAPI within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It tests API endpoints such as getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete, mainly focusing on the API's behaviors and exception handling. It sets up test data, mocks dependencies, and verifies responses within the testing framework.

classes.name: CandidateOfferDecliningAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class designed to verify the behavior of the CandidateOfferDecliningAPI endpoints such as getOne, update, delete, and related validation methods within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin. It utilizes mock services and fixtures to simulate real API interactions.
